notes.title: Wishlist our new game, Cubic Cosmos, on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are the development team of "Looper Tactics", and we're thrilled to announce our new game, Cubic Cosmos.

During the development of Looper Tactics, we were fortunate to meet a group of players who truly supported us and provided valuable feedback. Your encouragement and insight have fueled our motivation and gratitude. Thank you for being there for us!

Cubic Cosmos is still a card strategy roguelike game, but we didn’t want to stick to traditional gameplay. Sticking too closely to popular card games like Hearthstone or Slay the Spire can make it difficult to push the boundaries of innovation.

For this new game, we explored many different concepts. In the end, we decided to go with a gameplay system inspired by Tetris, which we’re temporarily calling "falling card battles." You’ll get a feel for it once the demo is available.

Our goal is to give you a unique experience. You’ll be able to play cards easily to grow your attributes, trigger various effects, and enjoy taking down enemies. In this new project, we've expanded the gameplay possibilities and removed many of the limitations on card play.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3332600?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=firstpv]The Steam store page[/url] for Cubic Cosmos is now available! Please show your support and add it to your wishlist. 

To learn more about Cubic Cosmos, join our community Discord.

notes.title: Meet Infinite Challenges: Roguelike Mode Major Update IS OUT NOW！
notes.content:
Hello, gamers!

In this update, we've introduced a new Roguelike challenge mode to the game. This mode offers a pure card-battle experience, perfect for players who simply want to enjoy the thrill of card battles. The roguelike mode will be regularly updated and is available for all players who own the base game.  


Let's check out what's new in this update:  

[h1]New Mode[/h1]
Introducing a challenge mode that strips away the storyline, catering to players seeking a straightforward card battle experience. Once players complete the B-level dungeon tutorial, they can opt to continue with the story mode or dive into the challenge mode. (You can back to the entrance of B-area to enter this mode if you have compeleted the tutorial.)  By activating the challenge mode, players can easily jump into dungeon battles using the UI button in the top right corner.

Players can seamlessly switch between the story and challenge modes, unlocking all basic cards, treasures, heroes, and more through either mode. The challenge mode features 10 difficulty levels, each introducing unique mechanics. Advancing through one difficulty level unlocks the next. Additionally, progressing in the story mode automatically unlocks the corresponding challenge mode difficulty to keep the gameplay balanced.

[h1]Feature Enhancements[/h1]
Players will now receive a special visual cue when the Flying Wings curse reaches its 4th count.
Memory fragment icons will now be visible on the maps of all story dungeons.

Linked cards and treasures will no longer randomly drop in the shop after completing an SSS dungeon but will instead be found in seal chests within any challenge dungeon after conquering an SSS dungeon.
Improvements have been made to display card tips correctly when selecting cards via Discover skills and the graveyard during battles.

[list]

[*] Enhanced the event transitions when switching card forms within dungeons.
[*] Tweaked the monster skill - Bash, increasing the action cost from 1 to 2.
[*] Implemented specific logic adjustments for Type-1's skill.
[*] Standardized the wording used in some skill descriptions.  
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the level of dual-form cards obtained after leveling up a card first was incorrect.
[*] Fixed the issue causing abnormal effects when using different hero cards in succession.
[*] Fixed the enlargement of cards obtained through Discover skills in the player's hand.
[*] Fixed the issue where certain skills would lose their counters when transitioning between turns.
[*] Fixed the issue that triggered conditions and text descriptions for Wild Breath for accuracy.
[*] Fixed the issue where the display discrepancy in Amplifier Element's skills, adjusting the text to reflect the actual effect.
[*] Fixed the issue where the aura of Amplifier Element failed to impact hero skill cards.
[/list]

notes.title: Rise of Human! “Looper Tactics” DLC “Tower and Sea” is now released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178732/7f2b3ed90a64cda3c2e46fd015c25344ce2fedcd.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

“Looper Tactics” DLC[b] “Tower and Sea” [/b]is now released! DLC includes a new Subtype-Human hero Fool, its related dungeons and new cards and other features. At the same time, brand new keywords such as Fuse, Sacrifice, etc. will be included in this DLC, providing richer card construction and gameplay experience.
 (DLC content can only be experienced after completing the S-level dungeon of the game itself and opening the S-level sealed gate.)

Soldiers! Grab your weapons! The war against the corrupt god is about to begin!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2727220/Looper_Tactics_Tower_and_Sea_DLC/

[h2]New Content of DLC[/h2]

DLC will include content related to the new Subtype-Human

[olist]
[*] A New Hero Fool

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178732/459ffc197db4eda859a8fac36b83e0eaf93a0acf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178732/5e8917b52e0bc863688785cd8ec6c759c8697ce8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178732/3db1bd431d997919a135132c9021f616c5c92fad.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178732/943e2a268a4908443e81c1d45f13c6ce60791310.png[/img]

[/olist]

[b]New Keywords[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Fuse[/b]： One minion is temporarily integrated into another, giving the latter all the skills of the former (except Ranged and Dodge).
[*] [b]Sacrifice[/b]： Choose a minion and feed it with minion cards in your hand to trigger the Sacrifice skill. After a certain number of times, it will be temporarily promoted to a higher grade.
[*] [b]Unite[/b]： Trigger this skill whenever a friendly card is summoned, or a minion card is sacrificed.
[*] [b]Conjure[/b]： Choose one of several cards and immediately use it.

[/list]

In addition to DLC content, we added a new dragon hero Queen and some new keywords, but also optimized a series of functions and bugs:

[h2]New Content of the base game[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178732/91ca2f27f3464c20749a2874850890afce57a8b6.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added a new dragon Hero Queen.
[*] Added a new skin for Hero Forest.
[*] New Keyword Sweep： Whenever it attacks, it deals damage equal to its ATK to adjacent minions on both sides of the minion in front of it as well.
[*] New Keyword Instinct： Whenever it triggers a passive skill (except this one), +1/+1 and permanently [5]+1/+1. Stackable.
[/list]

[h3]Optimization[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added a new function--“Ban-Gallery”. Players can choose cards or treasures to ban in the gallery, and it will no longer drop in stages. 
[*] Added a new function-- "Disable Treasures". Treasures will be disabled in the stage after selecting this function.
[*] Added a buff column of hero during combat. When pointing to the Hero avatar, the permanent buff of the hero will be displayed.
[*] Added display of the number of remaining cards during combat.
[*] The prompt of guidance in the menu will no longer disappear when selecting a card to gift some specific skills in the stage event.
[*] Added a menu-switching button in the gallery, which allows players to switch to other cards or treasures that can be upgraded.
[*] Optimized the trigger rules of the skill's special effect, which the special effect will only play once when some skills get triggered continuously, for example, the combination of Common Treant and Moonlight Idol.
[*] Optimized the rule of shield. Adding a new shield to a minion that already had one will cause the last shield to break and then add a new shield (Some skills will get triggered when shield broken).
[*] Fixed a lagging issue caused by buying cards in-store when there are too many cards in your hand.
[*] Optimized the counting rule of skill.
[*] Added different difficulty to World in a Box II.
[*] Now some skills that would drop hero skill cards will also drop hero skills cards from the random event.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the special effect of shield may overlap sometimes.
[*] Fixed an issue where Curse - Flying Wings would count across turns.
[*] Fixed an abnormal target selection issue of Smoke Dagger.
[*] Fixed an issue where battle would get stuck sometimes.
[/list]

Along with the release of the DLC "Tower and Sea", the Steam trading card of "Looper Tactics" will also be published. You can collect cards while playing the game, and combine them into badges that can be displayed on your profile. Emojis and profile backgrounds will also be dropped, so we hope you enjoy them.

We are continuing to develop more content, and if you encounter any issues during gameplay or have any suggestions or feedback, please don't hesitate to leave a message for us. We will promptly address any problems you encounter.

Once again, thank you for your support and appreciation. We will continue to work hard to meet your expectations and deliver an even better gaming experience.

Looper Tactics Team

notes.title: Exciting Updates in the 1.2.5 Version of Looper Tactics

2.	Fixed an issue where ranged minions may attack twice.
3.	Fixed an issue where there was a chance that the transformed minions would overlap when triggering illusion.

We are continuing to develop more content, and if you encounter any issues during gameplay or have any suggestions or feedback, please don't hesitate to leave a message for us. We will promptly address any problems you encounter.

Once again, thank you for your support and appreciation. We will continue to work hard to meet your expectations and deliver an even better gaming experience.

notes.title: Looper Tactics now is collaborating with Time Walker: Dark World!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today, we have some exciting news to share with everyone. Looper Tactics is now officially collaborating with Time Walker: Dark World. Time Walkers from the Dark World will transform into formidable Boss waiting for everyone to challenge him and add him to your deck. Additionally, two powerful treasures from Time Walker are also waiting for you to claim and add to your inventory.   

Here is the content of collaboration:
1. Added a new BOSS——Time Walker, will be added to random pool of the World in a box I and World in a box II. 
New BOSS: Time Walker
Skill 1: Dark World, every time you use the next life, eliminate all the minions on the battlefield.
Skill 2: Holy Light, Fast Casting: restore 10 HP to all and put a Secondary Holy Light card in both players' hand. (Secondary Holy Light: restore 10 HP to all)
Skill 3: Combo Claw – True, whenever 3 cards are drawn, deal 2 damage to 2 random enemy minions and gain +1 Skill Damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178732/740a55753fc758b5b93de79f45e0ad694df8d697.png[/img]

2. “Time Walker” card will be added to random pool after clear Ending 4 of Level-SSS stage.
New Card: Time Walker
Form 1: Cost 3 of Elemental, Deployed: give you and a friendly minion permanently [15] +2/+2, and deal damage to all enemies equal to its ATK (benefit from its skill damage bonuses), then destroy it.
Form 2: Cost 4 of Elemental, whenever you use a Healing spell card, give all minions permanently [20] +2/+2. Whenever you use a Damage spell card, restore 5 HP to all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178732/8e1a80754d2f4ab4137a27666ac8dc768b5f4a76.png[/img]

3. Added two treasures from the Dark World, which will be also added to random pool after clear Ending 4 of Level-SSS stage.
New Treasure: Assassin’s Heart
Treasure Effect: Whenever a minion dodges, put a Smoke Dagger in your hand. Triggers once per turn. (Smoke Dagger: Fast Casting: deal ranged damage that is equal to your damage to one enemy, and give two random friendly minions with the Dodge skill permanently [10] +1/+1.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178732/33050745458e83f1ddf2c79d95c4157b84b76259.png[/img]

New Treasure: Mage’s Heart
Treasure Effect: Whenever a minion triggers Aggravation, put a Magic Missiles in your hand. Triggers once per turn. (Magic Missiles: Delayed Casting: deal 3 ranged damage to 3 random enemies. Repeat once for each minion with Aggravation you have.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178732/652e407a53ffd5732d3fcda2ee9f20bc13c45386.png[/img]

We are very grateful to Time Walker: Dark world for bringing a new power of time and space to the fantastical world, and we also welcome everyone get in the dark world and join the faction of time walker. If you are interested in Roguelike combat, you should not miss Time Walker: Dark World, because you will find the unique element from the fantastical world in the dark world.

notes.title: Exciting Updates in the 1.2.0 Version of Looper Tactics

Hello everyone!

Today, we are excited to bring you the 1.2.0 Version update for Looper Tactics. We added multiple functions system and a brand-new stage, and a series of functional optimizations. We really appreciate all feedbacks and suggestions from players to help us better optimize gameplay experience.

notes.title: Exciting Updates in the 1.1.0 Version of Looper Tactics
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Thank you for your support and appreciation. Today, we are excited to introduce the latest update for Looper Tactics. We have made comprehensive improvements to various aspects of the game, including its features and cards, and have also introduced some exciting new mechanics to enhance your gaming experience.

Here is the content in this update:

[h2]I. Basic Function Enhancements[/h2]
1.	The card catalog now includes a filtering function that allows you to filter by the first and second forms of cards.
2.	When completing a challenge level with a score, the completion screen will display the total challenge score.
3.	The item backpack now displays the hero's attack, health, skill damage, and challenge score.
4.	Added animated indicators to the red dots when cards meet evolution conditions.
5.	Adjusted the position of certain main storyline event tiles to make them more noticeable.
6.	Optimized the sound that plays with text, making it less jarring.
7.	Enhanced the clarity of certain interface texts.
8.	Improved the translation of texts.

[h2]II. New Game Mechanics[/h2]
1.	Hero Cards: These cards restore health, change your avatar, and grant a hero skill card each turn.
2.	Hero Skill Cards: Various hero skills can now be used in card form.

[h2]III. Optimization of E-level Dungeons and World in a Box.[/h2]
1.	Adjusted the difficulty levels of various dungeons.
2.	Added a new event - "World Rules," which randomly appears at the start of a dungeon and offers the various choices.
3.	Added bosses: "Soul Dragon - Red/Purple/Green." They appear after defeating the second boss if you reach a certain challenge score.
4.	Added a strengthening option in the timed events on the second day, allowing you to restore 20 health when on the brink of death. All timed events now provide +8 health instead of +5.
5.	Added an option in the timed events on days 3/4/5, granting +10% monster attributes and +2 challenge score.
6.	Reduced the cost of upgrading the Level 4 card pool from 500 gold to 400 gold.
7.	Added a return path on the third layer of the World in a Box.
8.	Adjusted the quantity and content of events on the map.
9.	Removed redundant text from the scoring rules description outside of the E-level dungeons.
10.	Added "Cannot Save" text to the descriptions of E-level dungeons and the World in a Box.

[h2]IV. Bug Fixed[/h2]
1.	Fixed an issue where triggering a discover effect when defeating a boss with multiple lives could lead to a game freeze.
2.	Fixed an issue where sound effect resources could become abnormal, causing battles to freeze under certain conditions.
3.	Fixed an issue where effects lasting for the current turn were not immediately cleared when a monster entered a new life.
4.	Fixed interface abnormalities when selecting the "Easy Mode" at the Altar.
5.	Fixed an issue where the exploration progress of the World in a Box remained at 0%.
6.	Fixed the issue where "Battle Banner of Purity" and "Shadow Mask" treasures were not dropping.
7.	Fixed an issue in E-level dungeons and the World in a Box where some welfare monsters did not award challenge scores.
8.	Standardized the card catalog upgrade attributes, resolving discrepancies in certain card attributes.
9.	Fixed the issue where repeatedly opening and closing the card backpack at the World Seal could result in stacking buffs.
10.	Fixed the incorrect pattern of the event level for recruiting the Strong Dragon.
11.	Fixed an issue where the "Corpse Transformation" skill only targeted demons.
12.	Fixed an issue where the Vice Demon Captain triggered its summoning effect twice when deployed (e.g., with the Battle Spirit Stone).
13.	Fixed an issue where using the "Roar" hero skill caused the boss to trigger it each turn.
14.	Fixed an issue where the "Coffin of the Dead" did not grant the "Unstable Bomb" card.
15.	Fixed attribute anomalies when upgrading the "Armored Guard."
16.	Updated the skill criteria for "Specter" to include "All."
17.	Fixed an issue where the epic skill "Invigoration" did not apply to heroes.
18.	Fixed an issue where the epic skill "Illusion" spawned a 2-cost "Flying eye" card.
19.	Corrected the frame colors of some buffs.
20.	Adjusted the size of some buff icons.

[h2]V. Battle Mechanic Enhancements[/h2]
1.	Temporary skill effects now cause the target to play a size-changing animation and sound effect as a visual cue.
2.	"Sacrifice" now targets two random entities instead of one.
3.	"Perfect Sacrifice" now affects all allies.
4.	"Illusion" and "Destruction" now only affect minions with action power ≤ 4.
5.	Added descriptions like "Fast Casting" to training cards for clarity.
6.	Added color distinctions to the revived card faces of the "Flaming Bird."
7.	Provided color distinctions for several blessing spells to make them easier to differentiate.
8.	The "Megalithic Idol" boss skill now triggers only three times per combat phase.

[h2]VI. Skill Enhancements (Skills with names containing '*' refer to the second form of the card)[/h2]
[b]Demon Cards:[/b]
1.	"Demon Guard" now also grants a hero skill card with action power 1.
2.	"*Megademon" changed from +1/+1 to +2/+2.
3.	"Vampire" changed from +1/+1 to +2/+2.
4.	"*Vampire" now grants permanent lifesteal to all friendly minions after attacking, and ranged minions gain an additional permanent +4/+4.
5.	"*Armored Demon" now also grants this skill to a friendly demon.
6.	"*Giant Demon" redesigned: when destroy a minion, +3/+3 and draw a minion, and deal 50 ranged damage to friendly minions whenever a friendly minion is summoned.

[b]Elf Cards:[/b]
1.	"Blessing of Toughness" now affects all allies.
2.	"Blessing of Nature" now adds +1 attack.
3.	"Parasitic Rout" now inherits 40% of the attributes of the summoner.
4.	"Guardian Idol" with no limit on turn triggers.
5.	"Megalithic Idol" redesigned: Guard, Shield, Death: Summon a stationary stone with Guard and Shield, inheriting 50% of the attributes.

[b]Mech Cards:[/b]
1.	"*Light Doll" changed from +1 attack to +1/+1.
2.	"*Repair Doll" changed from +1/+1 to +2/+2.
3.	"*Kinetic Device" now triggers its activation effect.
4.	"Support Mecha" now grants a permanent buff when a minion is summoned, providing a uniform +1/+1 bonus.
5.	"*Support Mecha" reduced its cost from 2 to 1.
6.	"Recycler" changed from +1/+1 to +2/+2 and now restores 3 health when triggered.
7.	"Mothership" now aligns the class of the bombs it summons with its own class.
8.	"*Mothership" redesigned: Ranged, whenever a friendly ranged minion attacks, it gains +2/+2 and +2 skill damage, and whenever an enemy minion dodges, it deals 5 damage to all enemies.

[b]Elemental Cards:[/b]
1.	"*Energy Essence" reduced its cost from 2 to 1.
2.	"Sealed Amber" now also grants a permanent +1/+1.
3.	"*Sealed Amber" now also draws a spell card.
4.	"Elemental Power" now grants +1/+1 to both itself and the rightmost minion when activated.

[b]Dragon Cards:[/b]
1.	"Drake" changed from triggering upon minion destruction to triggering upon attack.
2.	"*Drake" changed from +1 attack to +1/+1.
3.	"Great Dragon" changed from triggering upon minion destruction to triggering upon minion destruction and attack.
4.	"*Great Dragon" redesigned: When deployed, it grants +1/+1 to itself and discovers a hero skill card.
5.	"Raging Dragon" now activates after using a hero skill once, rather than twice.
6.	"Strong Dragon" changed to grant +1/+1 after each attack and move to the right each time.
7.	"Lair Guardian" changed from +1/+1 to +2/+2, Enrage trigger altered to activate after taking damage, and when triggered, randomly grants a minion card in your hand +2/+2.
8.	"*Lair Guardian" changed from +1/+1 to +3/+3 and now restores 50% health to friendly guarding minions when triggered.
9.	"*Dragon Mother" redesigned: When deployed, it grants +2/+2 to all friendly dragons and activates their skills.

[b]Neutral Cards:[/b]
1.	"*Soul Watcher" redesigned: Guard, All, after moving, randomly grants a friendly minion +1/+1, draws a spell card, and draws a minion card.
2.	"*Type-1" changed from +1/+1 to +3/+3.

[b]Treasures:[/b]
1.	"Helm of Summoning" redesigned: Now, it grants a random hero skill card each turn.
2.	"Hero's Golden Ring" changed to provide +10 gold coins after taking damage.
3.	"Sun of Chaos" and "Moon of Chaos" changed from +1/+1 to +2/+2.

We are continuing to develop more content, and if you encounter any issues during gameplay or have any suggestions or feedback, please don't hesitate to leave a message for us. We will promptly address any problems you encounter.
Once again, thank you for your support and appreciation. We will continue to work hard to meet your expectations and deliver an even better gaming experience.

notes.title: Development Plan for Looper Tactics
notes.content:
Dear players, greetings!

Firstly, we would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all those who have shown interest in and played "Looper Tactics". Since the game's launch, we have received a lot of feedback from players across various communities and the Steam comment section. We have read every single comment and your feedback has greatly inspired us, shedding light on both the strengths and weaknesses of the game. Whether it's criticism or praise, it all helps us refine the game further.

In the upcoming period, we are committed to optimizing the game to ensure an enhanced gaming experience for all players. We will refine the in-game card text descriptions to ensure better comprehension. Simultaneously, we will carry out targeted improvements to various features.

Upon stabilizing the current version of the game, we will proceed to the subsequent development stages which include the creation of new heroes as initially planned, along with the development of DLC content. We will continue to collect opinions and suggestions from players, dynamically adjusting our development plans to meet your needs.

[b]Here is an outline of our preliminary post-release update plan:[/b]

1.Introduction of a new dragon race hero.
2.Provision of new character illustrations for heroes "Powerful" and "Heartless".
3.Addition of a card-play history feature during battles.
4.Incorporation of a double-speed feature for battles.
5.Enhancement of map icon indications for better guidance.
6.Development of DLC content, encompassing new side-story campaign scenarios, challenging modes for new gameplay experiences, introduction of new cards (human faction), new heroes, and new artifacts.
7.Exploration of the feasibility of opening up Steam Workshop.

These outlined updates are preliminary and will be continuously adjusted based on your feedback. Lastly, if you encounter any issues during your gameplay or find certain design aspects unsatisfactory, please feel free to leave your comments in the designated section.
Once again, we express our gratitude for the support and affirmation from all players. We will persist in refining the game, aiming to live up to your expectations.

notes.title: LOOPER TACTICS Released Today on Steam!
notes.content:
2P Games is excited to announce the official release of their highly anticipated collectible card adventure with roguelite mechanics, Looper Tactics! [b]The game is now available on Steam for $10.99 / €10.79, and to celebrate the launch, we're offering a special 10% discount during the first week[/b]. 

Embark on an epic journey through dungeons, strategically craft powerful decks, and engage in the thrilling cycle of gameplay to break free from the curse that the Ancient Empire has bestowed upon you. Get ready to immerse yourself in the world of Looper Tactics and begin your quest for liberation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178732/06d1d43f73f3bf5241c8251d5088c6e5e1b05b9a.png[/img]

[b]ABOUT THE GAME[/b]

Looper Tactics mixes collectible card game and deckbuilding mechanics with roguelite elements. Explore dungeons and complete tasks to gain access to more powerful cards. Fight, die and repeat the cycle until you craft the most powerful deck in the game.

A long time ago, the ancient Empire created a world within a box and filled it with artificial souls. But fearing that its creation might end destroying their own reality, the Empire decided to seal that world-within-a-box and curse it to live in an endless cycle of reincarnations, ensuring its total isolation. Now, the time has come to break that vicious cycle. You are the one to free your world and defeat the ancient Empire once and for all! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178732/b817af4cffeb87a3e0449c81efbe6d193a088129.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178732/08eb198b80947f19cdccc83a74468fb1b5ca9c85.jpg[/img]

[b]KEY FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Explore a metroidvania-like board. Each board hides combats, puzzles, adventures and secrets. Deciding what places to explore is up to you -- remember that with great risk come even greater rewards!
[*] Build a deck with no restrictions. Mix and match items, scrolls, or hero skills and choose from a pool of different races that include elves, elementals, demons, and dragons.
[*] Improve your cards and embrace death. Looper Tactics encourages players to die frequently. Starting anew will let them progress even forward while keeping attributes and enhancements earned during previous runs.
[/list]
